Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0019: ldstr "STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.SAITOGREENHOUSE.DESC"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_001e: ldstr "Eighteen farm plots on three shelves, behind glass."
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0028: ldstr "STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.SAITOGREENHOUSE.EFFECT"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_002d: ldstr "Grows 18 crops on three shelves of six (pick the crop on the Config tab). The shelves follow the crop: hanging trays for ceiling crops such as Pincha Pepper, two levels of three for trees, one vine for the Ovagro Node.

Duplicants deliver the seeds, fertilizer and water, and harvest ripe crops at the base. Every crop follows a vanilla farm's rules: temperature, atmosphere and pressure, light or darkness, radiation and plant mutations.

Pipe gas into it to give the crops their own atmosphere, or leave it open to the room. A liquid pipe and a conveyor rail can bring the water and solids instead of Duplicants.

Built in, each after its vanilla building's research: glow tubes that light crops which need it (power by the light they add), Farmer's Touch, insulation and thermal regulation. In Spaced Out, a radiation lamp burns Phosphorite like Shine Bugs do to give mutated crops the radiation they need."

Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0050: ldstr "STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.SAITOAQUATICGREENHOUSE.DESC"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0055: ldstr "Eighteen underwater plots on three shelves, in a tank behind glass."
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_005f: ldstr "STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.SAITOAQUATICGREENHOUSE.EFFECT"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0064: ldstr "Grows 18 underwater crops such as Waterweed, Tublia and Starnacle on three shelves of six, with hanging trays for Seakomb (pick the crop on the Config tab).

Pipe liquid in to fill the tank up to its fill level: it is the crops' water and atmosphere, and a shelf above the waterline doesn't grow. Duplicants deliver the seeds and solid fertilizer and harvest at the base; a liquid output takes liquid harvests.

Built in, each after its vanilla building's research: glow tubes for crops that need light, Farmer's Touch, and thermal regulation of the whole tank (a Liquid Tepidizer and Thermo Aquatuner)."
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_006e: ldstr "STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.SAITOHANGINGGREENHOUSE.NAME"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0073: ldstr "Greenhouse"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0078: ldstr "SaitoGreenhouse"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0087: ldstr "STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.SAITOHANGINGGREENHOUSE.DESC"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_008c: ldstr "Eighteen farm plots on three shelves, behind glass."
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0096: ldstr "STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.SAITOHANGINGGREENHOUSE.EFFECT"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_009b: ldstr "Grows 18 crops on three shelves of six (pick the crop on the Config tab). The shelves follow the crop: hanging trays for ceiling crops such as Pincha Pepper, two levels of three for trees, one vine for the Ovagro Node.

Duplicants deliver the seeds, fertilizer and water, and harvest ripe crops at the base. Every crop follows a vanilla farm's rules: temperature, atmosphere and pressure, light or darkness, radiation and plant mutations.

Pipe gas into it to give the crops their own atmosphere, or leave it open to the room. A liquid pipe and a conveyor rail can bring the water and solids instead of Duplicants.

Built in, each after its vanilla building's research: glow tubes that light crops which need it (power by the light they add), Farmer's Touch, insulation and thermal regulation. In Spaced Out, a radiation lamp burns Phosphorite like Shine Bugs do to give mutated crops the radiation they need."
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_00a5: ldstr "STRINGS.DUPLICANTS.STATUSITEMS.GREENHOUSETOUCHING.NAME"

Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_01b8: ldstr "On: Duplicants harvest crops as soon as they're ripe. Off: ripe crops wait until you press Harvest, like a vanilla plant with auto-harvest off. As in vanilla, a crop left ripe drops its harvest by itself after a while (4 cycles for most crops)."

Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0203: ldstr "A built-in Farm Station: a Duplicant with the Farmer's Touch skill tends each crop with 5 kg of Fertilizer, which makes it grow faster for a while, like a vanilla Farm Station."
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_020d: ldstr "STRINGS.UI.USERMENUACTIONS.GREENHOUSEMIMIKAS.ON"

Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0221: ldstr "Mimika Pollination: Off"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_022b: ldstr "STRINGS.UI.USERMENUACTIONS.GREENHOUSEMIMIKAS.TOOLTIP"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0230: ldstr "Two slots in the middle of the middle shelf grow Mimika Buds instead of the crop (with hanging crops, in a small nursery on that row's floor). Each bud releases a Mimika into the greenhouse about every 5 cycles; Mimikas live 5 cycles, pollinate one growing crop a minute (+25% growth for 600 s) and harden into Mimillet (a Mimika Bud seed) when they die. Sweatcorn Stalks wilt without pollination.

When the greenhouse is too hot, too cold or the wrong air for the buds, a small nursery closes around them and keeps them comfortable for 20 W; its door opens to let each Mimika out."
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_023a: ldstr "STRINGS.UI.USERMENUACTIONS.GREENHOUSEMIMIKAS.NOROOM"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_023f: ldstr "Only with crops that take one slot: trees, the Ovagro Node and wide plants leave no room for Mimika Buds."
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0249: ldstr "STRINGS.UI.USERMENUACTIONS.GREENHOUSEBONBONBRANCHES.ON"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_024e: ldstr "Bonbon Branches: Harvest for Lumber"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0258: ldstr "STRINGS.UI.USERMENUACTIONS.GREENHOUSEBONBONBRANCHES.OFF"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_025d: ldstr "Bonbon Branches: Keep for Nectar"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0267: ldstr "STRINGS.UI.USERMENUACTIONS.GREENHOUSEBONBONBRANCHES.TOOLTIP"
Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_026c: ldstr "Keep: Bonbon Tree branches stay on the tree and make Nectar. Harvest: Duplicants cut grown branches for 75 kg of Lumber each, like a vanilla branch harvest; a cut branch makes no Nectar until it has grown back."

Greenhouse.ModStrings | Register | IL_0299: ldstr "Insulated: the inside takes the temperature of the gas piped in instead of the room's, and what the crops breathe out stays inside."
